crossRefs.note: Or how can you tell your brother, ‘Brother, let me remove the speck of chaff that is in your eye,’ when you yourself…

that the godless man may not reign, that there be no one to ensnare the people.
With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.
For the ruthless is brought to nothing, and the scoffer ceases, and all those who are alert to do evil are cut off—
You hypocrite! First remove the beam out of your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck out of your…
You hypocrites! Well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,
Leave them alone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit.”
“Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you devour widows’ houses, and as a pretense you make long prayers.…
Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
But Peter said to him, “May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could obtain the gift of God with…
But Saul, who is also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, fastened his eyes on him,
and said, “You son of the devil, full of all deceit and all cunning, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease…
He answered them, “Which of you, if your son or an ox fell into a well, wouldn’t immediately pull him out on a Sabbath…
Jesus answered them, “I did one work and you all marvel because of it.

translations.web: Therefore the Lord answered him, “You hypocrites! Doesn’t each one of you free his ox or his donkey from the stall on the Sabbath, and lead him away to water?
translations.bsb: “You hypocrites!” the Lord replied. “Does not each of you on the Sabbath untie his ox or donkey from the stall and lead it to water?
translations.kjv: The Lord then answered him, and said, Thou hypocrite, doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall, and lead him away to watering?
translations.asv: But the Lord answered him, and said, Ye hypocrites, doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall, and lead him away to watering?
